description: This file is a utility module that provides a function to convert raw deployment status codes into human-readable labels for display in a UI. It handles string normalization, space collapsing, and title casing, including support for apostrophes.

methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts a raw status code string (e.g., 'in_progress', 'FAILED') into a human-readable label (e.g., 'In Progress', 'Failed') for display purposes. Handles null/undefined inputs by returning 'Unknown', replaces underscores and hyphens with spaces, collapses multiple spaces, and applies title casing including support for apostrophes.
